sources.label: Morphe patches for Gemini with microG and Samsung Secure Folder support
sources.author: Gemini microG
patch_list: Account ID Fallback for Clone
UNSUPPORTED historical experiment. Do not select: breaks account synchronization/login. Patching will stop if enabled.
Account Switch Lock Bypass
UNSUPPORTED historical experiment. Do not select: breaks account synchronization/login. Patching will stop if enabled.
Account Sync Binder Loop Fix
UNSUPPORTED historical experiment. Do not select: breaks account synchronization/login. Patching will stop if enabled.
Allow Work Profile Gemini Eligibility
Secure FolderでのWORK_PROFILE_NOT_SUPPORTED (19)を、既存のプロファイル許可分岐で回避します。
Automatic Clone Setup
Automatically creates the fixed .morphe clone and isolates its permissions and providers. No official Clone app or Expert mode configuration is required.
Bypass Work Profile Gemini Restriction
セキュアフォルダ（Work Profile）環境下でGeminiネイティブUIの起動を拒否しWeb版へリダイレクトする制限をバイパスします。
GmsCore Bytecode Redirect (MicroG RE)
Redirects GMS package/permissions/provider references to app.revanced.android.gms. Tested with microG RE 7.3.0; the previous 7.0.0 title was not a version requirement.
GmsCore Signature and Availability Bypass
Google Play Services の署名不一致 (SERVICE_INVALID) や可用性チェックを常時成功 (SUCCESS / true) にバイパスします。
Google App Manifest Tweaks
アプリ表示名を 'Google (Morphe)' に変更し、MicroG可視性を付与し、Split制約解除とクラッシュレシーバー無効化を行います。
Google App Package Clone Support
Redirects Google package and owned permission references to .morphe. Automatic Clone Setup handles package, permission and provider isolation with the default selection.
MicroG Account Permissions
Requests account access and microG extended access on Gemini startup.
MicroG Device Compliance Redirect
microG利用時にGoogleアプリ内の未認定警告へ転送するローカル分岐を抑止します。端末認定は変更しません。
Process Name Spoofing for Clone Support
クローン環境下でプロセス名から .morphe を自動除去し、Dagger DI コンポーネントの初期化クラッシュを防止します。

sources.label: Run the Gemini app inside Android work profiles (Shelter, Island, Secure Folder)
sources.author: Gemini Work Profile
patch_list: Allow work profile
Lets Gemini run in a work profile (Shelter, Island, Secure Folder) instead of asking to use the personal profile (errors 19 and 900009) or opening the web app.
microG support
Installs the Google app as a separate clone that signs in with microG (app.revanced.android.gms) instead of Google Play services. microG must be installed in the same profile.
Request microG permissions
Asks for account access and microG extended access when Gemini starts, so signing in works without granting them manually.
Skip uncertified device warning
Skips the local "device is not Play Protect certified" screen that the bundled Google Play services client shows with microG. Does not change any device or server certification state.
Unlock update-required chats
